boundary.path_allocation_note: 190mohm includes protected-pack leads, connector/crimps, fuse, BQ25616 BATFET and PCB copper, with the documented factory lead-extension variant; requires measured assembly acceptance. Capacity reserve covers pack internal loss/early cutoff separately. Thermal and fuse tolerances are allocations, not manufacturer guarantees.
boundary.capacity_reserve: 20% allocation for capacity loss and early cutoff; converter and external path losses separate. This is a design allowance, not a proven discharge-curve equivalence or lifetime guarantee.
boundary.capture_voltage_node: VBAT after connector and fuse, referenced to board GND; not protected pack output
boundary.path_loss_source_node: Protected pack output before external leads and board path;3.2V here is a conservative low-source loss/stress assumption

camera.method: sum of LDO output currents; external DVDD remains powered in every conservative case

firmware_seen.frame_rate_status: OV5640 registers target 9.99756fps with 24MHz XCLK, HTS2060,VTS2622. Actual frame timestamps and skipped frames remain recorded. No sensor power reduction assumed.

sd.source_note: Selected SDCIT2 manufacturer sheet publishes no current limits.100mA average/300mA peak are design assumptions, requiring selected-card characterization.

esp32.note: 286mA is a Wi-Fi TX peak at 100% duty, not a guaranteed continuous part maximum; CPU allowance is separately duty-weighted in realistic case.

cases.name: conservative_sustained_design
cases.notes: ESP32 published TX operating point held continuously; SD100mA is a design assumption, not a manufacturer maximum. Scenario calculation, not guaranteed runtime.

cases.name: realistic_duty_budget
cases.notes: Wi-Fi: 15% TX at 286mA + 85% RX at 95mA = 123.65mA; CPU: 25% at 107.9mA dual-core 240MHz modem-sleep ceiling = 26.975mA. Combined ESP allowance is 150.625mA and must be measured.

cases.name: peak_converter_sizing
cases.notes: Instantaneous sizing only: ESP TX operating point and assumed SD300mA peak; this case is not a sustained runtime prediction.

acceptance: Measure the external battery path at temperature and require <=190mohm equivalent; retain current/voltage traces.
Measure combined ESP current and TX/RX/CPU duty with actual VGA JPEG traffic.
Measure SD current at SPI20MHz with sustained writes; retain peak trace for converter sizing.
Measure all rails and battery current at thermal steady state for >=30 minutes and record frame rate, cutoff, and efficiency.
